articles.summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced that the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock for the month of October 2026. The dividend will be paid on November 16, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 26, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of October 26, 2026. Financial Highlights as of September 30, 2026 Total investment portfolio including TBAs of $8.0 billion Unrestricted cash and unencumbered investments of $401.3 million Total repurchase agreement borrowings of $6.8 billion Estimated book value per common share of $6.74 (1) Debt-to-equity ratio of 7.6x and economic debt-to-equity ratio of 8.3x (2) (1) Estimated book value per common share as of September 30, 2026 is calculated as total stockholders' equity less the liquidation preference of the Company's Series C Preferred Stock ($168.1 million), divided by total common shares outstanding of 109.1 million.
